Matching contraction and directed alternating-cycle correspondence reduce anti-forcing to a feedback-arc number, and the 4096-state subset recurrence is proved by optimal-last-vertex induction. All 169 minima computed. The 48 explicit group actions partition matchings into 17 orbits with exact sizes, anti values and complementary cycle partitions. Independent minimum-transversal optimization agrees for each of 17 orbit representatives. Standalone verifier executed with VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: A complete weighted polynomial plus 17 symmetry types for the canonical S4 permutohedron is a precise natural finite combinatorial invariant of polyhedral matching theory. It refines the known maximum and set-valued spectrum by exact multiplicities and symmetry, and its two-factor collision examples show complement cycle type cannot recover the deletion optimization. The classification is not an arbitrary restricted graph slice, and no infinite-family extension is claimed.
